_note: Per-camera traffic rules for violation checks. Polygons are in normalised image coordinates (x/width, y/height) of reference_frame; every other frame is first mapped onto that frame (camera pan removed, violations.camera_motion). allowed_direction is the permitted direction of travel in the image (x right, y down); [0, -1] = away from the camera, up the frame. Only FIXED cameras get rules: on a moving camera, image motion is relative to the camera, not the road. Zones were drawn by hand from the clips (DECISIONS E18).

cam_fixed_overpass_01.description: Overpass view of a one-way carriageway; all traffic moves away from the camera.

cam_fixed_high_01.description: High view of a divided road; the main carriageway (between the median and the right kerb) is one-way away from the camera. The road beyond the right kerb is excluded.
